commits.notes: Frozen open-source reference workflow specification, synthetic fixtures, and self-contained validator.
Locked reproducible open-source compilers, runtimes, providers and self-contained resource validator.
Unified local Go engine setup, loopback supervisor, clean shutdown, and smoke tests verified.
Typed versioned domain inputs and results v1, Go engine contract validation, limits and cancellation, and C04 fixtures verified.
ADR-0003 local single-writer storage port, atomic manifest publication, stable operation IDs, idempotency replay, and interrupted/disk-full recovery verified.
Engine clean-checkout verification, runtime.yml CI workflow, ENGINE_TESTS documentation, and positive/negative security invariant suites verified.
Domain model for route and resource classes implemented in internal/policy/model.go; F01 public routes explicit and unspecified routes default-private verified.

Bounded local OPA policy bundle evaluator implemented in internal/policy/opa.go; F02 invalid policy and deadline deny/error semantics, tampered byte detection, and monotonic authority retention verified.
Offline decision fixture simulator implemented in internal/policy/simulator.go and cmd/policyhelix/main.go; F03 changed allow/deny decisions with reasons and policy digest verified.
Deterministic signed policy bundle builder implemented in internal/bundles/build.go and cmd/policyhelix/main.go; F04 bundle records issuer, digest, revision and validity period verified.

Bundle trust and freshness verification implemented in internal/bundles/verify.go and cmd/policyhelix/main.go; F05 unsigned, tampered, expired, or replayed bundles rejected before activation verified.

Atomic bundle activation and rollback implemented in internal/bundles/activate.go and cmd/policyhelix/main.go; F06 active bundle switches atomically and failed activation retains prior bundle verified.
OIDC callback validation implemented in internal/auth/oidc.go and cmd/policyhelix/main.go; F07 wrong issuer, wrong audience, replayed nonce, and expired tokens rejected verified.

Revocable server-side session persistence implemented in internal/auth/session.go and cmd/policyhelix/main.go; F08 session fingerprints, redacted server-held credentials, and cookie rotation against fixation verified.

Bounded 30-second stale authorization window enforcer implemented in internal/auth/revoke.go and cmd/policyhelix/main.go; F09 revoked session stops within configured 30-second bound under target workload verified.
Gateway identity normalization implemented in internal/gateway/identity.go and cmd/policyhelix/main.go; F10 client identity headers stripped before trusted values are constructed verified.

Allowlisted single upstream proxy and origin isolation implemented in internal/gateway/proxy.go and cmd/policyhelix/main.go; F11 arbitrary upstream URLs cannot be selected and origin is reachable only by gateway verified.

Policy obligation enforcement and fail-closed handling implemented in internal/gateway/obligations.go, internal/gateway/proxy.go, and cmd/policyhelix/main.go; F12 unknown mandatory obligation denies rather than being ignored verified.

Per-resource outage behavior and fail-closed handling implemented in internal/gateway/failure.go, internal/gateway/proxy.go, and cmd/policyhelix/main.go; F13 decision loss denies sensitive routes and public route bypass remains intentional and testable verified.
Decision audit logging and credential redaction implemented in internal/audit/decision.go; F14 decision includes subject pseudonym, policy and outcome without bearer token or cookie verified.
Policy simulator and decision diff UI implemented in apps/web/src/pages/Simulator.tsx; F15 UI displays policy revision and explains changed decision using fixture context verified.
Gateway health and session revoke dashboard implemented in apps/web/src/pages/Gateway.tsx; F16 operator sees stale policy, IdP outage and revocation result without exposing tokens verified.

Candidate policy shadow execution and auditable divergence tracking implemented in internal/rollout/shadow.go and tests/shadow_test.go; F17 shadow decision never changes enforced result and divergence is auditable verified.
